q: Why did my sales drop yesterday?

Your sales did not drop yesterday — net sales were ₹91,220 on 2026-10-13, up from ₹40,119 on 2026-10-12 (+127%); the data shows an increase, not a drop, and the day sits inside the measure's normal range.

- Offsetting changes: discounts increased ₹1,553 → ₹5,173 (reduced net sales by ~₹1,824) and return/cancel revenue fell (contribution −₹15,813 vs its usual), but these were smaller than the orders/AOV lift.  
- Ad spend and sessions rose (ad spend ₹38,661 → ₹50,442, +30%) and moved with sales, but the analysis found no single upstream cause — the system classifies these as correlations, not proven causes.
